source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. The theme of a mysterious girl in a grey cloak who appears and vanishes like a figure from an old book: ethereal, tender and ancient, a little lonely, gently fading like a lamp's afterglow. Very quiet and intimate so dialogue sits on top of it. Tempo 66 BPM, 4/4 time, key of E minor. Instrumentation: solo celesta and harp, a soft solo violin, sustained string harmonics, a quiet low piano, faint chimes. Form: celesta and harp motif; violin melody; harmonics and piano bridge; motif returns softly. Duration: 90 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
